study_identification_part.si4_title: A neuroimaging measure to capture heterogeneous patterns of atrophy in Parkinson ' s disease and dementia with Lewy bodies

answer: Reference normative cortical thickness/subcortical volume cohort (58,836 participants across 82 sites; Rutherford et al. 2022)
UCL Vision in Parkinson's disease site (108 PD, 36 DLB, 38 controls; T1w MRI)
NACC ADRC 8361 site (25 DLB, 127 controls; T1w MRI)
dc1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Neuroanatomical normative model pretrained on a 58,836-participant multisite reference set and applied to two study cohorts: the UCL Vision in Parkinson's disease cohort and the NACC ADRC 8361 cohort providing PD/DLB patients and controls.
dc1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "Their reference cohort comprised 58,836 participants from 82 sites." ... "Structural T1w-MRI data from two sites were used. The first site at University College London (UCL), included 108 participants with PD, 36 with DLB and 38 controls..." ... "The second site was the pseudoanonymised Alzheimer's Disease Research Center (ADRC) '8361' ... and included 25 participants with DLB and 127 controls."

answer.Reference normative cohort: Provides pretrained normative trajectories for cortical thickness and subcortical volumes.
answer.UCL Vision in Parkinson's disease cohort: PD and DLB patients plus controls supplied for transfer-learning recalibration of the normative model and for clinical analyses.
answer.NACC ADRC 8361 cohort: Controls used for recalibration; DLB participants used as clinical evaluation cohort.

dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Reference dataset supplies the baseline normative model; UCL and NACC controls recalibrate the model to study data, while PD/DLB cases from those sites are the clinical application/test populations.
dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "The reference normative model was recalibrated to the study datasets with an adapted transfer learning approach... inputting control data from our two study sites into the reference normative model... Z-scores were then generated for each individual with DLB or PD."
dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Bhome2024.pdf.md: 2.5 Applying neuroimaging normative modelling to study data

dc3_number_of_healthy_control.detail: Reference normative training set: 58,836 healthy participants across 82 sites. Study-specific controls used for recalibration: 165 total (38 UCL + 127 NACC).
dc3_number_of_healthy_control.supporting_text: "Their reference cohort comprised 58,836 participants from 82 sites." ... "We included 108 participants with PD ... 61 people with DLB ... plus 165 controls (38 from UCL, 127 from NACC), used to calibrate the reference dataset models to the study data."

dc4_age_info.detail: The paper lists cohort sizes but does not provide age summary statistics for the healthy reference set or the 165 controls used for recalibration.
dc4_age_info.supporting_text: "Their reference cohort comprised 58,836 participants from 82 sites." ... "plus 165 controls (38 from UCL, 127 from NACC), used to calibrate the reference dataset models to the study data" (no age descriptors given for controls).

dc5_sex_info.detail: Sex breakdowns are reported for PD and DLB patients but not for the healthy reference cohort or the 165 controls used in transfer learning.
dc5_sex_info.supporting_text: "We included 108 participants with PD ... 61 people with DLB ... plus 165 controls" (sex counts only provided for PD/DLB groups in Table 1).
